name: buckley-large-19
original:
fix(model): resolve role models owned by non-default providers (#215)

* fix(model): resolve role models owned by non-default providers

- Drop the per-provider ownership gate in modelAvailable; the aggregated catalog is already provider-scoped, so a guessed default provider wrongly failed valid role models.
- Exclude the exact requested name from closestModelMatches, because a suggestion that repeats the failed name explains nothing.
- Add regression tests for codex-first provider ordering and for suggestion exclusion.


* fix(model): fix model provider resolution to prefer catalog owner

- Add catalogOwnerForModel to read the provider that advertised a model ID from the aggregated catalog.
- Apply the catalog-owner tier after the explicit prefix, routing rule, and default provider, so configured defaults still win.
- Fix codex-mode regression where a config-role model owned by a non-default provider failed startup validation and dispatched to another provider.
